searchText: Are there representatives for Trezor/Ledger in this group? Trying to get an idea for when EIP-1559 support will land on those devices. I have created a issue with ledger and <@!333694584607604738> already had one created with Trezor. <@!464858726344425472> no idea on timelines - just tried to get the ball rolling 😉 https://tenor.com/view/woah-shocked-domino-gif-17459289 I'm available for assisting in any attempt to get support landed on those devices ahead of the hardfork. Even if that's just owning the communication on one of those threads. For reference https://github.com/trezor/trezor-firmware/issues/1604 and https://github.com/LedgerHQ/app-ethereum/issues/150 Related: If a dependency doesn't support EIP-1559, would it make sense to use EIP-1559 estimation and then just set gasPrice based on computed maxFeePerGas, similar to how backwards compatibility of legacy transactions is achieved? Would that potentially produce a better result (*for the user*) than using legacy txs. Thanks a lot for having us the call today . Will the recording be made public as I feel i might have missed some things
